parse.title: Elden Ring
parse.text:
Awards

[edit | edit source]

Elden Ring received over 300 Game of the Year awards,[1] including by the publications Ars Technica,[2] Destructoid,[3] EGM,[4] Eurogamer,[5] Game Informer,[6] GamesRadar+,[7] GameSpot,[8] IGN,[9] PC Gamer,[10] and Polygon.[11]
